page_title: AUX 0-0 PSG | Auxerre v PSG 06/12/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' That's it for today, Jeremie Pignard has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+4' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from PSG comes to nothing.
90+4' Close! Desire Doue (PSG) picks up a pass and produces a ferocious strike towards the right post, but the goalkeeper gets his fingertips to the ball to keep it out.

90+4' Randal Kolo Muani (PSG) runs onto a loose pass inside the box and releases a tremendous shot low towards the middle of the goal. However, Donovan Leon anticipates the shot and makes an easy save.
90+3' Ousmane Dembele (PSG) fails to deliver a decent cross from the corner and the ball goes out of play.
90+3' Achraf Hakimi (PSG) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to PSG.
90+1' PSG can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
90' We will have 4 min. of added time.
90' Ousmane Dembele (PSG) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The referee points to the corner flag and PSG will take a corner.
86' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Auxerre, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
85' Willian Pacho (PSG) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Jeremie Pignard had an easy-decision to make.
84' Christophe Pelissier has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Paul Joly (Auxerre) replacing Ki-Jana Hoever.
83' It is time for a substitution. Theo Bair (Auxerre) is on for Lassine Sinayoko.
82' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Auxerre was in an offside position.
81' Ousmane Dembele (PSG) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.
79' Luis Enrique decides to make a substitution. Fabian Ruiz will be replaced by Marco Asensio (PSG).
78' PSG have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
77' Here comes a substitution. Gaetan Perrin is given a rest as he is replaced by Ado Onaiwu (Auxerre).
76' Lassine Sinayoko (Auxerre) behaves unsportingly. Lassine Sinayoko (Auxerre) receives a yellow card.
75' Vitinha (PSG) picks up a pass and fires a powerful long-range shot which goes painfully close to the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Auxerre.
73' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Hamed Junior Traore (Auxerre) was quite harsh and Jeremie Pignard didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
72' PSG take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
71' Jubal (Auxerre) rises highest from the corner to head at goal, but his effort towards the middle of the goal is comfortably saved by the goalkeeper.
71' The referee blows his whistle, Auxerre are awarded a corner kick.

70' Hamed Junior Traore (Auxerre) receives a precise pass and is given time inside the box to send a promising strike towards the right post. Gianluigi Donnarumma guesses his intention and denies him with a fine save. The referee signals a corner kick to Auxerre.
69' A great pass puts Vitinha (PSG) clear inside the box, he sidesteps the keeper but inexplicably hit his shot off the crossbar.
67' Substitution. Desire Doue (PSG) on for Kang-In Lee.
66' PSG quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
66' Achraf Hakimi (PSG) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball. PSG have been awarded a corner kick.
66' Kang-In Lee (PSG) sends in the corner, but fails to find the head of any of his teammates, allowing the defence to clear.
62' Luis Enrique has decided to substitute Goncalo Ramos and he is replaced by Randal Kolo Muani (PSG).
62' Substitution. Ousmane Dembele (PSG) replaces Bradley Barcola.
62' Vitinha (PSG) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
62' Vitinha (PSG) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is easily cleared out of danger.

61' Nuno Mendes (PSG) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to PSG.
59' The corner is swung in but PSG can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
59' Fabian Ruiz (PSG) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence. Corner kick. PSG will have an opportunity.
57' PSG take a short corner kick.

56' Achraf Hakimi (PSG) unleashes a promising shot towards the right side of the goal after his wonderful solo run, but Donovan Leon thwarts the effort with a fabulous save. The score remains the same. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. PSG will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
54' Vitinha (PSG) floats the ball in from the corner but it's intercepted.
54' Kang-In Lee (PSG) picks up a sweet pass and fires one in from distance towards the left side of the goal, but Donovan Leon is alert and makes a decent save. Now PSG have a corner.

53' Fabian Ruiz (PSG) took a first-time shot from mid-range after he was put in the clear by a great pass, but the effort lacked a little accuracy and went just wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Auxerre.
51' The resulting corner, taken by Kang-In Lee (PSG), comes to nothing.

49' Donovan Leon pulls off a great save to deny Goncalo Ramos (PSG) after receiving a precise defence-splitting pass. The effort is headed for the bottom left corner, but the goalkeeper dives superbly to stop it. Definitely the best save of this match so far!
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+2' The end of the first half.
45' 1 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' Nuno Mendes (PSG) produces a poor pass. He attempts to get the ball into the box but it's hacked away.

44' Kang-In Lee (PSG) makes a yard for himself and attempts to endanger the goalkeeper with a long-range shot. His great effort, however, goes a whisker wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Auxerre.
40' Auxerre take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
39' A cross from the free kick is whipped in by Kang-In Lee (PSG), but one of the defenders steps in and averts the threat.

38' Jeremie Pignard blows his whistle for a foul after Gideon Mensah (Auxerre) hacks down one of his opponents. It's a free kick to PSG, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.
36' The free kick from long range, taken by Auxerre, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
35' Bradley Barcola (PSG) brings his opponent down. Jeremie Pignard has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul. Auxerre are awarded the free kick.
35' Goncalo Ramos (PSG) rises above the opponent's defence and heads a precise cross towards the middle of the goal. His effort, however, is blocked by Donovan Leon, who pulls off a comfortable save!
34' Kang-In Lee (PSG) steps up to take the corner. He launches the ball into the penalty area, but it only finds the head of an opposing player who clears the danger.

32' Nuno Mendes (PSG) receives a diagonal pass, bursts into the box and shoots towards the right side of the goal. Donovan Leon is well positioned, though, and it's a comfortable save. The ball goes out for a corner. PSG can continue in their attacking effort.

30' Jeremie Pignard blows his whistle after Bradley Barcola (PSG) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle. It's a free kick to Auxerre, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.
30' The goal by PSG is DISALLOWED on the advice of the video assistant referee due to an offside.
29' Attention! Referee Jeremie Pignard straight away wants to review previous situation with VAR, presumably for a possible offside in the build-up.
28' Fabian Ruiz (PSG) has a goal ruled out for offside!
27' PSG seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
22' Nuno Mendes (PSG) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
20' Auxerre fail to threaten from the corner kick as the opposition's goalkeeper plucks the ball out of the air.
19' PSG fail to score from a corner as Donovan Leon (Auxerre) leaps to collect the ball.

18' What a save from Donovan Leon! Goncalo Ramos (PSG) jumps high to meet a cross and glances a promising header from close range towards the top right corner, but the goalkeeper pulls off a brilliant save to keep it out. PSG force a corner. They send men into the box.

11' Gideon Mensah (Auxerre) put a cross into the box which wasn't a bad decision, but he failed to achieve what he wanted as none of his teammates managed to meet it. The ball is out of play. PSG will take a throw-in.
8' Fabian Ruiz (PSG) tries an acrobatic volley inside the box that disappears way over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Auxerre will have a goal kick.
8' Bradley Barcola (PSG) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
7' PSG are ruled offside.
4' PSG failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
3' A long cross from the side is directed to the well-positioned Nuno Mendes (PSG), but the defence gets it clear. The ball goes out of play and PSG have been awarded a corner kick.

3' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. PSG are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
PSG will kick the game off.
The referee of today's match will be Jeremie Pignard.
Show lineups The starting lineups of both teams are already revealed and you can check them out in the details of this match.
